div.head: III Em Rubriken
div.ab: I. De iuratione que fiebat Eadmundo regi. II. De fure. III. Qui alterius hominem receperit uel ad dampnum aliquem manutenuerit. IIII. De seruo fure. V. Ignotum pecus non emendum sine testimonio. VI. De inuestigando pecore furato. VII. Ut quisque suos faciat credibiles; et de infamatis; et de eis qui hec precepta negligunt.

[ I. De juratione quae fiebat Eadmundo regi. II. De fure. III. Qui alterius hominem receperit vel ad dampnum aliquem manutenuerit. IIII. De servo fure. V. Ignotum pecus non emendum sine testimonio. VI. De investigando pecore furato. VII. Ut quisque suos faciat credibiles; et de infamatis; et de eis qui haec praecepta negligunt.] [M, Hk, Br]

[I. Of the oath taken to King Edmund. II. Of the thief. III. He who has received another [into his service], or has maintained [harboured] someone to another's detriment. IIII. Of the thieving slave. V. Unknown cattle are not to be purchased without [witness] testimony. VI. On investigating stolen cattle. VII. Of [the need for] each [lord] to provide surety; and of those of ill-repute; and of those who neglect these laws.]
div.note: Latin only (Quadripartitus); Liebermann prints no German translation. This list of rubrics (in MHkBr, missing from T) seems to derive only from the Latin text, so was probably added in the latest Quadripartitus edition (Liebermann). Text placed after III Eg in T; between I and II Em in MHkBr; missing from Lond and R.
